description: S51 T2 (TM5), the closed sets AS ANSWERED — assembled from ValidationStates(), PriorityStates() and AllowedTransitions(), never restated into a second list that could drift. The two sets print separately because D2 says they are different questions; legalNext names, for each validation state, the states a move may legally land on (D1: nothing moves back to unvalidated, ever — a re-attempt is a NEW attempt record). The board's filters and every write's state words are only ever these words. S51 T6 (TM9) added the two authority statements: the words the daemon puts BEFORE an enabling verb, carried in the SAME answer so the CLI and the UI quote ONE string (S50 RM9's law). `aeon triage validate` and `handoff` print theirs and act only on --yes.

result.validateStatement: This starts a validation attempt — an ordinary loop under the blueprint triage.validationBlueprint names, run by the daemon; the bug stays unvalidated until its reactor lands the outcome (S51 TM9).
result.handoffStatement: This hands the bug off to the roadmap — a validated, prioritized bug becomes a roadmap item under provenance triaged, through S26's own door (S51 TM9, D8).
